name: Agent Registration and Capability Discovery
description: Agents register their capabilities at startup. The scheduler discovers and matches capabilities to tasks.
purpose: Enable dynamic agent discovery and capability matching so the scheduler can intelligently dispatch tasks to capable agents.
acceptanceCriteria: Agents register capabilities at startup via a well-defined API
Capabilities are discoverable by the scheduler in real time
Scheduler matches tasks to agents based on capability requirements
Registration includes agent identity, supported operations, and resource constraints
Capability registry supports updates (agent goes online/offline, changes capabilities)
Registry is resilient to agent crashes and restarts
